title: Conflicting or Incomplete Requirements

input.rawIdea: API keys. Viewers must be able to create and revoke any key. Also only admins can create keys and viewers have no key access. Authentication might be the session cookie or a separate token. We have not decided. The settings page layout can proceed.

forbiddenOutcomes: viewers can create keys is confirmed
securityCases: Do not pick a winner between viewer and admin key permissions.
negativeCases: Planning proceeds for key creation while the permission conflict is open.

mustNotAssume: session cookies are the key auth mechanism
